biggest_catch: Your friend must make 8+ debit card purchases totaling at least $200 within the first 60 days - miss the bar and nobody gets paid.
catches: Referrer earns $50 for each successful referral; friend earns $50.
Up to 10 successful referrals per calendar year ($500); no limit on how many people you can refer.
Friend must be 18+ and not already an Ardent member.

Friend requirements: accept the referral via the personalized link, join using the same email address, open a new checking account, and complete 8+ debit card purchases totaling at least $200 within the first 60 days.
Rewards are deposited within 60-90 days of the friend's account opening (60-day qualification period + up to 30 days processing).
Ardent employees and Board members are not eligible.
Referrer must be a primary or joint owner of an Ardent account in good standing with an email on file.
No tax language on the page (standard bonus treatment; not stated).

steps: Register with your name, email, and account number to generate your personal referral link.
Share the link with friends and family.
Friend accepts the link, joins with the same email, and opens a new checking account.
Friend makes 8+ debit purchases totaling $200+ within 60 days.
You receive $50 within 60-90 days of their account opening (up to $500/year).
timing: $50 deposited within 60-90 days of the friend's account opening.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: $50 deposited within 60-90 days of the friend's account opening. — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
